lines.name: Priya Raghunathan
lines.content: Hi Doug, Priya from United Material Handling. Is now still a good time for the fifteen minutes we booked?

lines.name: Doug Nyquist
lines.content: It is. I will say up front we are also talking to Crown Equipment.

lines.name: Priya Raghunathan
lines.content: That is useful to know. What matters most in the comparison for you, so I make sure I am answering the right question?

lines.name: Doug Nyquist
lines.content: Uptime, honestly. We lost about forty hours last year waiting on parts.

lines.name: Priya Raghunathan
lines.content: Then let me be specific rather than general. We stock the wear parts for this class locally, and our service contract has a four hour on site response. I would rather show you the response log than claim a number.

lines.name: Doug Nyquist
lines.content: That would help. What is the budget range we are talking about?

lines.name: Priya Raghunathan
lines.content: For six units with that contract, roughly 260000 all in. I want to confirm the parts pricing with our service manager before I put a number in writing.

lines.name: Doug Nyquist
lines.content: Understood. I need something written by Friday, our board meets the following Tuesday.

lines.name: Priya Raghunathan
lines.content: Then I will send the quote and the response log by Thursday end of day, so you have a day to read it before Friday. I will also copy Ellen Vance since you mentioned she signs off.
